versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) infographic generator skill.
- Supports 11 unique visual styles and 8 information layouts, optimized for XHS engagement.
- Automatically splits content into 1–10 cartoon-style images for social media sharing.
- Offers flexible style and layout selection, including combined presets for common content scenarios.
- Provides detailed documentation and usage examples for generating infographics directly or via file input.
